newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT-Argentina's Telecom started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Argentina's Telecom started as buy.

text.p: Societe Generale Securities announced Thursday it initiated coverage of Telecom Argentina with a buy recommendation.

"While the company's growth potential has declined somewhat, the risks it faces have been even further reduced as a result of improvements in the Argentine regulatory system ... and a projected decrease in the company's financial leverage," senior Latin American Equity Reeserach analyst Jose Linares wrote in a report.
He projected a 12-month price target of $66 and a dividend yield of 3.3 percent that represent a projected total return of 20-22 percent.
Linares forecasts fiscal 1997 and 1998 earnings per ADS of $3.10 and $3.75 respectively and revenue growth of 7.1 percent and 10.2 percent respectively.
Telecom, with about 46 percent of the domestic market, is Argentina's second-largest phone company.

It is controlled with a 60 percent stake by Nortel Inversora SA, formed by Italy's STET (32.5 percent), France Telecom unit France Cable et Radio (32.5 percent), Argentine conglomerate Perez Companc (25 percent) and J.P. Morgan (10 percent).
